metadata.title: Clicked like I’m swatting a fly and somehow got 2 poor souls?! Valorant aim threw logic out
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like my mouse is a confused squirrel
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-confusion
How did that even connect twice? No clue but I’ll take it
If your aim ever pulls a double surprise, this one’s for you

Tap if your aim ever surprises even you mid-panic

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
